description: Defines thread pool utilities for caffe2, including thread worker classes, aligned memory allocation, synchronization primitives, and a worker pool implementation.

classes.name: AllocAligned
classes.description: Provides aligned memory allocation and deallocation for type T.

classes.name: AlignedDeleter
classes.description: Custom deleter for aligned memory unique_ptr.

classes.name: MakeAligned
classes.description: Factory for creating aligned std::unique_ptr instances.

classes.name: BlockingCounter
classes.description: Synchronization primitive to wait for N events.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Abstract base class for tasks executed by workers.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a worker thread in the thread pool, manages task execution and thread lifecycle.

classes.name: WorkersPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker threads, distributes tasks, and handles synchronization.

methods.name: alloc
methods.description: Allocates aligned memory for type T.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Deallocates aligned memory for type T.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a std::unique_ptr<T, AlignedDeleter<T>> with aligned memory.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the BlockingCounter to a specified count.

methods.name: DecrementCount
methods.description: Decrements the counter and notifies if zero.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits until the counter reaches zero.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute task logic.

methods.name: ThreadFunc
methods.description: Main loop of the worker thread.

methods.name: StartWork
methods.description: Assigns a task to the worker and signals it to run.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Distributes tasks among worker threads and runs one task on the current thread.
